predictions.text: I predict that the Strait of Hormuz will be targeted again, with Iran attacking another naval facility there.
I predict that over 200 additional garment factories will shut down in Bangladesh due to worker protests by the end of Sunday, 22 November 2026.
I predict that student protesters, unions, and the yellow vests will hold another nationwide protest in France, with over 100,000 participants.
I predict that the Free trade agreements of Canada will not be debated in the Canadian parliament this week.
I predict that the recovered funds will be used to fund social programs in Hungary, with the majority allocated to education and healthcare.

I predict that the investigation into the explosives seizure in Kanaighat Upazila, Sylhet District, Bangladesh, will lead to the arrest of additional suspects and the seizure of more explosive materials in a related operation involving Bangladeshi and Indian security forces.
I predict that the first stop of the winners' tour for the Eurovision Song Contest Asia will be in Thailand.

I predict that the United States will arrest and charge individuals from the designated Guatemalan criminal groups, and these groups will face additional sanctions such as asset freezes and travel bans.
I predict that the parliaments of both Qatar and Turkey will approve the defense pact by the end of Sunday, 22 November 2026.
I predict that the Nations Championship final will be won by Australia, defeating Scotland at Murrayfield Stadium, Edinburgh.
